runs.question: How many days of annual leave do I get after 3 years with the company?

sources.heading: 3. Leave > 3.1 Annual leave
sources.text:
Annual leave is paid. The number of days depends on your length of service on 1 January of each year, and is counted in working days.
Length of service: Less than 2 years; Annual leave: 8 days; Sick leave (outpatient): 14 days
Length of service: 2 years to less than 5 years; Annual leave: 12 days; Sick leave (outpatient): 18 days
Length of service: 5 years or more; Annual leave: 16 days; Sick leave (outpatient): 22 days
Unused annual leave of up to 5 days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse without payment.

sources.heading: 3. Leave > 3.2 How to apply for annual leave
sources.text:
- For 1 or 2 days, apply at least 3 working days before the first day of leave.
- For 3 days or more, apply at least 14 days before the first day of leave.
- Apply in the HR portal. Your supervisor approves or declines within 2 working days.
- Leave is not approved during stocktake, which runs in the last week of June and the last week of December.

sources.heading: 3. Leave > 3.5 Public holidays and unpaid leave
sources.text: The company observes all federal and Sabah public holidays gazetted for the year, including the Kaamatan harvest festival on 30 and 31 May. The list is published every December. Unpaid leave of up to 30 days in a year may be approved by the General Manager. Emergency leave, for example after a serious accident at home, must be reported within 24 hours and is deducted from annual leave.

sources.heading: 3. Leave > 3.3 Sick leave and hospitalisation
sources.text: The number of paid sick leave days without hospital stay is in the table in 3.1. You must tell your supervisor by 9:00 am on the first day of absence, by phone or message, and give a medical certificate from a registered doctor on your return. If you are admitted to hospital, you receive up to 60 days of paid sick leave in a year, which includes the outpatient days.

answer.answer: You get 12 days of annual leave after 3 years with the company [1].

runs.question: How much is delivery to Keningau and how long does it take?

sources.heading: 2. Delivery zones, lead times and charges
sources.text:
The zone is decided by the delivery address. Charges are before any tax and are separate from goods prices in the price list.
Zone: A; Areas: Kota Kinabalu, Penampang, Putatan, Inanam; Lead time: Next working day; Delivery charge: RM25; free for orders of RM800 or more
Zone: B; Areas: Tuaran, Papar, Kota Belud; Lead time: 2 working days; Delivery charge: RM60; free for orders of RM2,000 or more
Zone: C; Areas: Ranau, Keningau, Kudat, Beaufort; Lead time: 3 working days; Delivery charge: RM120; free for orders of RM3,500 or more

sources.heading: 1. Taking and confirming orders > 1.2 Heavy and large orders
sources.text: Orders of more than 100 bags of cement, more than 2 tonnes in total, or any item longer than 6 metres need 2 working days notice, because they need a crane truck or a second lorry. Sales staff must tell the customer when they quote.

sources.heading: 1. Taking and confirming orders > 1.1 Cut-off times
sources.text:
An order is confirmed when the customer has accepted the quotation and, for new customers, paid. Orders confirmed by 3:00 pm from Monday to Friday are delivered on the next working day in Zone A. Orders confirmed after 3:00 pm count as received on the next working day.
For Saturday delivery in Zone A, the order must be confirmed by 11:00 am on Friday. There is no delivery on Sundays or public holidays.

sources.heading: 3. On the day of delivery > 3.1 Delivery windows
sources.text: Customers choose a morning window (8:30 am to 12:30 pm) or an afternoon window (1:30 pm to 5:30 pm). The dispatch office sends a message the evening before with the window and the driver's name. A driver may take at most 14 drops on one route.

answer.answer: Delivery to Keningau takes 3 working days [1]. Delivery to Keningau costs RM120 [1].

runs.question: Can I return unopened goods, and is there a fee?

sources.docTitle: Customer price list and terms of sale
sources.heading: 5. Returns and warranty > 5.1 Returns
sources.text: Goods that are unopened, undamaged and in stock condition may be returned within 7 days of delivery with the delivery order. A restocking fee of 10% of the goods price applies. Cut-to-size items, mixed paint and special orders cannot be returned.

sources.heading: 4. Problems > 4.3 Nobody to receive the goods
sources.text: The driver waits 15 minutes and calls the customer twice. If nobody can receive the goods, the driver returns them to the warehouse and the order is booked for redelivery. A redelivery charge of RM40 applies in Zone A, and the normal zone charge applies elsewhere. A customer can move a delivery once without charge, if they tell the dispatch office before 12:00 noon on the working day before.

sources.docTitle: Customer price list and terms of sale
sources.heading: 5. Returns and warranty > 5.3 Counter hours
sources.text: Branch counters are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 1:00 pm. They are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

sources.heading: 3. On the day of delivery > 3.2 Unloading
sources.text: Drivers unload goods at the kerb or at a ground-floor point named by the customer, and the customer must have people ready to unload. Carrying goods upstairs or over more than 30 metres is not included. A helper can be booked in advance for RM50 per hour.

answer.answer: Unopened, undamaged goods in stock condition may be returned within 7 days of delivery [1]. A restocking fee of 10% of the goods price applies [1].

runs.question: How soon must I report an accident to the Safety Officer?

sources.heading: 5. Accidents and breakdowns > 5.1 After an accident or near miss
sources.text:
- Stop, switch on the hazard lights and check for injuries. Call 999 if anyone is hurt.
- Do not admit fault and do not agree to settle in cash at the scene.
- Take photos of the vehicles, the road and the damage, and note the names of witnesses.
- Report to the Safety Officer by phone within 1 hour, even for a near miss or minor damage.
- Give a written report within 24 hours, on the incident form.

sources.heading: 5. Accidents and breakdowns > 5.2 Breakdowns
sources.text: Move the vehicle off the road if you can and switch on the hazard lights. Place the warning triangle at least 50 metres behind the vehicle. Call the dispatch office. Do not attempt roadside repairs other than changing a tyre when it is safe.

sources.heading: 4. Problems > 4.1 Damage and shortages
sources.text: The customer must check the goods at delivery and write any damage or shortage on the DO before signing. Damage or shortage found later must be reported to dispatch@tanjungsampel.example with photos within 24 hours of delivery. Reports after 24 hours are accepted only for damage that could not be seen at delivery, and not later than 3 days after delivery.

sources.heading: 5. Personal data and breaches > 5.2 Reporting a breach
sources.text: A data breach is any loss, theft or exposure of personal or company data, for example a lost laptop, an email sent to the wrong person or a stolen password. Report it to the IT Manager immediately and in any case within 4 hours of finding out. IT contains the problem, and the General Manager decides within 72 hours whether customers or authorities must be told.

answer.answer: Report to the Safety Officer by phone within 1 hour, even for a near miss or minor damage [1].
